failure_mode: Cannot reliably detect data-caused failures
early_warning: Expert review finds many triggers are requirements, implementation, access, or reasoning failures.
mitigation: Precision-first classifier; human approval; explicit missing-info schema; compare against public docs and user clarification.
notes: Fatal to horizontal thesis unless one vertical has reliable labels.

failure_mode: False-positive failure-node triggers waste budget
early_warning: Developers disable the tool after surprise charges or low-value calls.
mitigation: Buyer approval; spend caps; free-source check; conservative thresholds; refund policy.
notes: False positives create both economic and trust failure.

failure_mode: False negatives make the broker irrelevant
early_warning: Buyer says the broker missed the moments where it would have helped.
mitigation: Begin with explicit annotations and IDE commands; tune from labeled pilot traces.
notes: Recall can improve after a precision-first pilot.

failure_mode: Outcome measurement is too noisy
early_warning: Success stories cannot survive controlled before/after evaluation.
mitigation: Fixed task suite; randomized baselines where feasible; expert labels; accepted/rejected diff tracking.
notes: Fatal to outcome-ranking moat; may leave services business.

failure_mode: Buyers will not pay broker markup
early_warning: Procurement asks for direct vendor introduction or pass-through pricing.
mitigation: Pre-negotiate renewal price; sell audit/provenance/control-plane value.
notes: Core brokerage economics fail if this persists.

failure_mode: $0.01-per-call economics cannot support the company
early_warning: Usage grows but gross profit per account remains trivial.
mitigation: Price per resolved workflow or enterprise control-plane subscription; batch settlement.
notes: Fatal to micropayment model; not necessarily to enterprise SaaS.

failure_mode: Sales cycle is too long for a startup pilot
early_warning: Thirty-day test becomes six-month vendor review.
mitigation: Synthetic/deidentified tasks; existing entitlements; one data owner; paid design partner.
notes: Common in healthcare, finance, legal, and government.

failure_mode: Platforms internalize failure detection
early_warning: Agent platforms add native missing-context or recommended-tool flows.
mitigation: Treat hosts as channels; build vertical supply, rights, and outcome evidence.
notes: Coding-agent detection likely belongs inside Cursor/Claude Code/Copilot/etc.

failure_mode: Observability companies expand into classification
early_warning: Existing LangSmith/Langfuse/Braintrust/Datadog stack identifies the failure class.
mitigation: Integrate with observability; own rights registry and source-resolution economics.
notes: Fatal to observability-only product.

failure_mode: Context7-class free substitutes eat the public-docs wedge
early_warning: Most triggers involve public libraries, SDKs, or docs available through Context7-like tools.
mitigation: Exclude public docs; require non-public, licensed, outcome-critical vertical data.
notes: Public-doc wedge is already compressed.

failure_mode: Data owners expose direct MCP/API endpoints
early_warning: OpenSanctions, Reuters, Stack Overflow, PitchBook, or ICC-like sources offer direct connectors.
mitigation: Provide cross-source routing, entitlement normalization, eval evidence, and policy controls.
notes: Fatal if buyer needs only one source.

failure_mode: Direct deals bypass marketplace
early_warning: Legal teams remove broker from renewal path; source asks buyer to contract directly.
mitigation: Target mid-size buyers needing multiple sources and agent-specific audit.
notes: Weakens generic marketplace.

failure_mode: Rights holders refuse reseller or agent-use terms
early_warning: Supplier permits only human UI use or internal API use.
mitigation: Source-hosted queries; no raw corpus; no training; output limits; provider approval rights.
notes: No supply means no broker.

failure_mode: Chain-of-title failure
early_warning: Supplier contract has carveouts, exclusions, or no AI/automated-use warranties.
mitigation: Rights diligence; representations; indemnities; source exclusions; counsel review.
notes: One public chain-of-title incident can poison the market.

failure_mode: HIPAA/PHI and healthcare compliance overwhelm RCM pilot
early_warning: Pilot cannot use real claims or model providers without lengthy BAA/security review.
mitigation: Use synthetic/deidentified fixtures; avoid PHI first; prefer compliance/KYB first.
notes: Fatal to healthcare-first speed, not all verticals.

failure_mode: Privacy/GDPR/permissible-purpose restrictions block use
early_warning: Privacy team refuses trace export or automated processing of personal data.
mitigation: Data minimization; DPA; processor mapping; subject-bounded queries; audit logs.
notes: High risk in KYB, identity, credit, insurance, and employment.

failure_mode: Moat not preservable for rights holders
early_warning: Provider demands impractically low query caps or forbids production output retention.
mitigation: Answer-only APIs; thresholds; rate limits; anomaly detection; permitted derived-work terms.
notes: Fatal if no acceptable answer shape exists.

failure_mode: Multi-homing compresses margins
early_warning: Providers list on Snowflake, Cloudflare, xpay, direct MCP, and broker simultaneously.
mitigation: Compete on workflow/audit/eval value; avoid toll-booth assumptions.
notes: Fatal to network-effect story.

failure_mode: Platform or cloud marketplaces tax away economics
early_warning: Enterprise buyer requires procurement through a cloud or agent marketplace.
mitigation: Price for channel margin; use marketplaces after direct pilot proof.
notes: Caps upside and margin.

failure_mode: Buyer already has entitlements
early_warning: Buyer asks to connect existing account instead of buying through broker.
mitigation: Support BYO-license mode with SaaS fee and entitlement checks.
notes: Reframes brokerage into integration/control plane.

failure_mode: Missing data is buyer-owned, not externally purchasable
early_warning: Traces point to internal databases, credentials, schemas, or business policy.
mitigation: Proceed only when external rights holder is identifiable.
notes: Broad thesis shrinks materially.

failure_mode: Agent hosts restrict telemetry or tool routing
early_warning: Enterprise policy disables external MCP or trace export.
mitigation: Human-in-the-loop MCP; approved enterprise deployment; private networking; host partnerships.
notes: Distribution risk.

failure_mode: Latency breaks developer workflow
early_warning: Developers bypass broker because waiting interrupts agent runs.
mitigation: Cache permitted metadata; async approval; narrow tools; source SLAs; batch checks.
notes: Especially important in synchronous IDE use.

failure_mode: Source data is wrong, stale, or low coverage
early_warning: Expert reviewers find the licensed source misses paid-for edge cases.
mitigation: Source-version receipts; coverage metadata; fallback routing; warranties; source ranking.
notes: May kill a vertical if gaps are structural.

failure_mode: Liability for wrong answers is unacceptable
early_warning: Contracts demand uncapped indemnity or production reliance warranties.
mitigation: Decision-support framing; human review; limited pilot use; liability caps; warranty clarity.
notes: High in healthcare, legal, finance, and construction.

failure_mode: Sponsored/ranked source recommendations damage trust
early_warning: Buyer asks whether broker chose best source or highest-margin source.
mitigation: Disclose commercial relationships; separate ads from quality ranking; avoid sponsored discovery in MVP.
notes: Avoidable early.

failure_mode: Metering and settlement disputes erode both sides
early_warning: Broker ledger diverges from buyer or provider logs.
mitigation: Append-only usage ledger; provider log comparison; monthly invoicing; dispute process.
notes: Operationally important but not inherently fatal.

failure_mode: Security/log leakage of proprietary content
early_warning: Red-team finds raw provider responses in traces, PRs, or support tools.
mitigation: Redaction by default; short TTLs; no raw storage; approved subprocessors; provenance receipts.
notes: Can become fatal after breach.

failure_mode: Dataset reconstruction through repeated queries
early_warning: Query patterns cover broad cross-products instead of task-specific cases.
mitigation: Query templates; budgets; similarity detection; corpus thresholds; anomaly suspension.
notes: Fatal if rights holders cannot trust controls.

failure_mode: MCP/payment rails commoditize the build
early_warning: Buyers describe product as MCP plus billing.
mitigation: Build vertical schema, rights registry, and outcome evals; buy payment rails.
notes: Fatal to infrastructure-only startup.

failure_mode: Weak founder focus drifts into horizontal marketplace
early_warning: Roadmap prioritizes self-serve supplier onboarding before pilot renewal.
mitigation: Hard gates: one vertical, one failure node, one buyer, one data owner.
notes: Strategy discipline is a major requirement.

failure_mode: Data-owner concentration destroys margin
early_warning: Provider demands minimum guarantees, high prices, or customer ownership.
mitigation: Start with broker-friendly supplier; add second source after demand proof.
notes: Acute in healthcare, legal, finance, and standards.

failure_mode: Buyer asks for services, not software
early_warning: Invoices are mostly implementation hours; tool usage is low.
mitigation: Charge for pilot services knowingly, but measure repeatability and support load.
notes: Fatal to venture thesis; viable services business.

failure_mode: No path to defensible demand graph
early_warning: Too few comparable events per source/failure class after pilots.
mitigation: Require aggregation rights; repeated task suites; defer moat claims.
notes: Fatal to $1B horizontal story.

failure_mode: Free/public official sources are good enough in first vertical
early_warning: Licensed-source lift over public baseline is below pilot threshold.
mitigation: Choose premium enrichment or payer/local/authority data where public baseline is insufficient.
notes: Kills that vertical/failure node.

failure_mode: 30-day pilot cannot access realistic traces
early_warning: No real runs or task fixtures by week two.
mitigation: Require task set before signing; use synthetic representative fixtures.
notes: Should trigger pause or re-scope.
